title: DarGlobal projects in Saudi Arabia — official portfolio index
text: Snapshot checked 2026-11-19. DarGlobal's official Saudi Arabia portfolio page lists projects including Trump Park Residences (Amaya, Jeddah); Trump Mansions (Rayana, Wadi Safar, Riyadh); Trump Executive Residences (Amaya, Jeddah); Amaya luxury plots (Jeddah); Padel Living Residences (Jeddah); Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad (Riyadh); and Trump Tower Jeddah. This is a portfolio catalogue, not live inventory. Confirm current unit availability, prices, and terms with DarGlobal.

title: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad — official project page
text: Snapshot checked 2026-11-19. DarGlobal describes Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad as branded villas in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The page lists the project as under development and lists five-bedroom villas. Its FAQ gives a scheduled completion of December 2027. The page describes community amenities including schools, public parks, a sports hub, restaurants, retail, and healthcare clinics. The page does not establish current unit availability or price; confirm those with DarGlobal.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah — official project page
text: Snapshot checked 2026-11-19. DarGlobal describes Trump Tower Jeddah as a 47-floor seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche. The page lists one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses, with areas from 70 to 365 square metres. The project is under development, with completion scheduled for December 2029. Amenities listed include a concierge, meeting rooms, gym, pools, and dining. The page states DarGlobal is the owner and developer and uses the Trump name under license; the Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller. Confirm current availability, prices, and terms with DarGlobal.
